newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind met president Emil Constantinescu, Foreign Minister Adrian Severin and Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea.
At the end of his visit, Rifkind said Romania's democratic progress would have a serious impact on NATO's enlargement plans.
* Constantinescu to start talks with leaders of opposition parties in the afternoon.
* Romania will privatise Romtelecom RA telephone company with help from a foreign strategic investor, Communications Minister Sorin Pantis told a news confference.
* Telephone tariffs to rise by 80 percent starting February 1, the communications ministry said.
